row.body: The seed bag is kept beside a water bottle; the notebook page where the plot directions should be has been removed.
row.title: Plot with no note

sidecar.gloss: Garden supplies remain with their directions missing.
sidecar.rival_reading: A household garden could leave the same supplies together; the missing page does not identify the crop or its purpose.

row.body: Orchard diary: at the apple mark, windfalls carried a waxy film after the trial pass. The buyer rejected them before any evacuation notice.
row.title: Apple mark beside treated windfalls

sidecar.rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.

row.body: Repair receipt: the hammer mark identifies the pump sealed after drawing cloudy field water. Its gasket was new, yet the metal inside had turned green.
